STRIPE_GET_UPCOMING_INVOICE_LINE_ITEMS.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of line items for an upcoming invoice preview. Use when you need to see detailed line items before an invoice is finalized.

limit.description: Maximum number of line items to return (range: 1-100, default: 10).

coupon.description: Coupon ID to apply (deprecated - use discounts instead).

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for preview (defaults to customer's currency).

customer.description: Customer ID whose upcoming invoice line items to retrieve. Either customer, subscription, or schedule is required.

schedule.description: Schedule ID for upcoming invoice line items. Cannot be used with subscription.

discounts.description: List of discount objects to apply. Each object must contain one of: coupon, discount, or promotion_code.

preview_mode.description: Preview calculation type: 'next' for next invoice or 'recurring' for recurring totals.

subscription.description: Subscription ID for upcoming invoice line items. Cannot be used with schedule.

automatic_tax.description: Settings for automatic tax lookup. Must include 'enabled' boolean.

ending_before.description: Cursor for backward pagination; returns line items before this ID. Mutually exclusive with starting_after.

invoice_items.description: Invoice items to add or update (max 250 items).

starting_after.description: Cursor for forward pagination; returns line items after this ID.

RENTMAN_GET_INVOICE_INVOICELINES.description: Tool to retrieve invoicelines linked to a specific invoice. Use when you need to get line item details including VAT amounts (BTW bedrag), prices, and ledger codes for a particular invoice.

id.description: Numeric ID of the invoice to retrieve invoicelines for.

HOLDED_GET_INVOICE.description: Return full details, lines, totals, and payment summary for one invoice by its Holded ID.

invoice_id.description: Holded invoice ID, a 24-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

RENTMAN_GET_INVOICELINES.description: Tool to retrieve invoicelines collection from Rentman. Use when you need to access invoice line items with details like VAT amounts, prices, and ledger codes. Supports pagination (up to 300 items per request), field selection, and sorting.

sort.description: Sort order. Prefix field names with '+' for ascending or '-' for descending. Example: '+id,-created'.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per request. Default and maximum is 300.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in response. Example: 'displayname,vatamount,base'.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default is 0.

STRIPE_RETRIEVE_UPCOMING_INVOICE.description: Tool to preview the upcoming invoice for a customer, showing all pending charges including subscription renewals and invoice items. Use when you need to preview invoice amounts before they are finalized, test the effects of subscription updates including prorations, or estimate future billing.

coupon.description: The code of the coupon to apply to the invoice preview. If multiple discounts needed, use the discounts parameter instead.

issuer.description: The connected account that issues the invoice. Can specify type ('self' or 'account') and account ID.

currency.description: The currency for the invoice preview. Three-letter ISO currency code. Defaults to customer's currency.

customer.description: The identifier of the customer whose upcoming invoice to retrieve. Required if subscription is not specified.

schedule.description: The identifier of the subscription schedule for which you'd like to retrieve the upcoming invoice. Cannot be combined with subscription or subscription_details parameters.

discounts.description: List of discounts to apply. Each discount can have coupon, discount, or promotion_code.

on_behalf_of.description: The account (if any) for which the funds of the invoice payment are intended. Used with Stripe Connect.

preview_mode.description: Determines the preview calculation type. 'next' (default) calculates the next invoice with all items. 'recurring' estimates long-term recurring bill.

subscription.description: The identifier of the subscription for which you'd like to retrieve the upcoming invoice. If not specified, uses the customer's default subscription.

automatic_tax.description: Settings for automatic tax calculation. Must include 'enabled' boolean field.

invoice_items.description: List of invoice items to add or update in the upcoming invoice preview. Maximum 250 items.

customer_details.description: Details about the customer used for this invoice preview. Can include address, shipping, and tax information.

schedule_details.description: Details for schedule creation or modification to preview. Include phases, end_behavior, and proration_behavior.

subscription_items.description: List of subscription items for subscription updates. Each item can have id, deleted, price, quantity, etc.

subscription_details.description: Subscription creation or modification parameters to preview. Can include items, proration_behavior, proration_date, billing_cycle_anchor, trial_end, etc.

subscription_cancel_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the subscription should be canceled. Used to preview the invoice that will be generated if the subscription is canceled at this time.

subscription_resume_at.description: For paused subscriptions, when to resume. Can be 'now'.

subscription_trial_end.description: Trial end for the subscription. Can be 'now' or a Unix timestamp.

subscription_cancel_now.description: Boolean to simulate immediate cancellation of the subscription.

subscription_start_date.description: Unix timestamp for when the subscription should start.

subscription_proration_date.description: Unix timestamp to use for proration calculations. Important: Use this same value when doing the actual subscription update to ensure matching prorations.

subscription_trial_from_plan.description: Boolean indicating if a default trial from the plan should be applied.

subscription_default_tax_rates.description: List of tax rate IDs to apply to the subscription items in this preview.

subscription_proration_behavior.description: How to handle prorations when updating subscriptions. Can be 'create_prorations', 'none', or 'always_invoice'.

subscription_billing_cycle_anchor.description: For new subscriptions, billing cycle anchor. Can be 'now', 'unchanged', or a Unix timestamp.

subscription_cancel_at_period_end.description: Boolean indicating whether the subscription should cancel at the end of the current period.
